topic: Calculating average data periods for campaigns
summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding the calculation of averages for campaign performance metrics. Specifically, it was questioned whether a 12-week average should be based on 12 distinct periods or if the period length (e.g., 14 days) dictates the averaging interval.

It was confirmed that when calculating averages, the metric is based on 'periods.' Furthermore, clarification was sought regarding how missing data points are handled in the calculation: whether only available data will be used for the average, or if periods with zero values will also be included.
decisions: Averages should be calculated based on distinct time periods.
action_items: Someone needs to verify how the averaging function handles incomplete datasets (i.e., if it includes zero-value periods or only available data).
